about: Hand-calculated optimizer test cases (task 8.1). Each case is a target written directly in the target format (docs/target-format.md), so the LLM isn't involved, and the answer worked out by hand. The rules the answers follow are in docs/optimizer-rules.md. The optimizer test runner (task 8.2) sends every case through the real search; frontend/tests/test_optimizer_cases.py re-adds every expected order from the chain files to check the hand math and catch price changes.

checks.combo_beats_parts: A combo or bundle is cheaper than the parts, sometimes even with an item the customer didn't ask for
checks.upsize: Making a combo large versus buying large sizes separately
checks.substitution: Choosing a non-default slot choice, with or without a charge
checks.two_combos_vs_extras: Two of the same combo versus one combo or a bundle plus separate items
checks.add_on: Add-ons, including on an item inside a combo
checks.budget_only: Budget-only targets (most calories, price breaks ties)
checks.calorie_goal: A calorie limit changes the answer
checks.no_calorie_data: Items with no calorie data: left out when calories matter, allowed otherwise
checks.tie: Two orders cost the same; either passes
